propositions: A deterministic import walk must verify every rebar.* module in the installed wheel probe via pkgutil.walk_packages + importlib, reporting all import failures (not fail-fast) to catch subpackage breakage and module-scope heavy-dep imports

A scripts/ import leg must import each top-level scripts/*.py in an isolated child process with scripts/ and CWD stripped from sys.path to prevent one script's sys.path.insert from masking a sibling's missing insert

Expected-optional modules (rebar._mcp_auth with [mcp], rebar.opcert_service.app and rebar.review_bot.app with [reviewbot]/[ui]) must be attempted but recorded as skips only when the declared dependency is absent and ModuleNotFoundError.name matches the declared dependency

The walk must be locally runnable without CI via make import-walk and python scripts/check_import_walk.py from a checkout with rebar installed, with one-line wiring in the wheel-probe step of _artifact-probe.yml

Regression tests must recreate the pre-fix bare-import shape (spinal-grayish-perch alert_dedup leak) and prove it caught by the isolated-child mechanism, plus prove multi-failure reporting via a synthetic package with two broken modules
